name: pyDAEDALUS — DX Wireframe Routing
description: Experimental: follows the original pyDAEDALUS routing, but no design made with this plugin has been folded yet. Check the result before ordering staples. Routes the active wireframe region's mesh with two-helix (DX) edges, B-form DNA and an M13 scaffold. Needs a closed mesh in an empty wireframe region, and rescales the mesh to the size of the design.

citations.text: Veneziano, R., Ratanalert, S., Zhang, K., Zhang, F., Yan, H., Chiu, W. and Bathe, M., Designer nanoscale DNA assemblies programmed from the top down, Science, 2016, 352(6293), p.1534.

parameters.label: Minimum edge length (bp)
parameters.description: Length of the shortest edge. The paper used 31, 42, 52, 63 and 73. Edges are rounded to whole helix turns.
